COMPONENT: Sheet8 \| TYPE=WORKSHEET / THISWORKBOOK MODULE \| LINES=69
  VBA 00001 \| 
  VBA 00002 \| Private Sub Worksheet_Change(ByVal Target As Range)
  VBA 00003 \|     Dim cell As Range
  VBA 00004 \|     Dim pos As Long
  VBA 00005 \|     Dim oldEvents As Boolean
  VBA 00006 \|     Dim rngLegacy As Range
  VBA 00007 \| 
  VBA 00008 \|     On Error GoTo CleanExit
  VBA 00009 \| 
  VBA 00010 \|     oldEvents = Application.EnableEvents
  VBA 00011 \|     Application.EnableEvents = False
  VBA 00012 \| 
  VBA 00013 \|     ' FORM BELANJA:
  VBA 00014 \|     ' Saat nama bahan A22 berubah, isi nilai awal dari MASTER BAHAN BAKU.
  VBA 00015 \|     If Not Intersect(Target, Me.Range("A22")) Is Nothing Then
  VBA 00016 \|         If Target.CountLarge = 1 Then
  VBA 00017 \| 
  VBA 00018 \|             If Len(Trim$(CStr(Me.Range("A22").Value2))) = 0 Then
  VBA 00019 \|                 Me.Range("B22:E22").ClearContents
  VBA 00020 \|             Else
  VBA 00021 \|                 IsiDefaultFormBelanja _
  VBA 00022 \|                     CStr(Me.Range("A22").Value2), True
  VBA 00023 \|             End If
  VBA 00024 \| 
  VBA 00025 \|         End If
  VBA 00026 \|     End If
  VBA 00027 \| 
  VBA 00028 \|     ' EVENT LAMA:
  VBA 00029 \|     ' Tetap aktif untuk input di kolom C,
  VBA 00030 \|     ' tetapi dilewati pada baris form 21-22,
  VBA 00031 \|     ' baris pemisah 23, dan header transaksi 24.
  VBA 00032 \|     Set rngLegacy = Intersect(Target, Me.Range("C15:C1000"))
  VBA 00033 \| 
  VBA 00034 \|     If Not rngLegacy Is Nothing Then
  VBA 00035 \|         For Each cell In rngLegacy.Cells
  VBA 00036 \| 
  VBA 00037 \|             If cell.Row < 21 Or cell.Row > 24 Then
  VBA 00038 \| 
  VBA 00039 \|                 If Len(Trim$(CStr(cell.Value2))) > 0 Then
  VBA 00040 \| 
  VBA 00041 \|                     ' Isi tanggal jika masih kosong.
  VBA 00042 \|                     If Len(Trim$(CStr( _
  VBA 00043 \|                         Me.Cells(cell.Row, 1).Value2))) = 0 Then
  VBA 00044 \| 
  VBA 00045 \|                         Me.Cells(cell.Row, 1).value = Date
  VBA 00046 \|                         Me.Cells(cell.Row, 1).NumberFormat = _
  VBA 00047 \|                             "dd/mm/yyyy"
  VBA 00048 \| 
  VBA 00049 \|                     End If
  VBA 00050 \| 
  VBA 00051 \|                     ' Perilaku lama: ambil bagian sebelum tanda "\|".
  VBA 00052 \|                     pos = InStr(1, CStr(cell.Value2), "\|")
  VBA 00053 \| 
  VBA 00054 \|                     If pos > 0 Then
  VBA 00055 \|                         cell.value = Trim$( _
  VBA 00056 \|                             Left$(CStr(cell.Value2), pos - 1))
  VBA 00057 \|                     End If
  VBA 00058 \| 
  VBA 00059 \|                 End If
  VBA 00060 \|             End If
  VBA 00061 \| 
  VBA 00062 \|         Next cell
  VBA 00063 \|     End If
  VBA 00064 \| 
  VBA 00065 \| CleanExit:
  VBA 00066 \|     Application.EnableEvents = oldEvents
  VBA 00067 \| End Sub
  VBA 00068 \| 
  VBA 00069 \|

COMPONENT: ModTutupBukuBulanan \| TYPE=STANDARD MODULE \| LINES=138
  VBA 00001 \| Sub TutupBukuBulanan()
  VBA 00002 \|     Dim wsStok As Worksheet
  VBA 00003 \|     Dim wsQty As Worksheet
  VBA 00004 \|     Dim answer As VbMsgBoxResult
  VBA 00005 \|     Dim openFolderAnswer As VbMsgBoxResult
  VBA 00006 \|     Dim mainFolderPath As String
  VBA 00007 \|     Dim folderPath As String
  VBA 00008 \|     Dim backupFileName As String
  VBA 00009 \|     Dim fullBackupPath As String
  VBA 00010 \|     Dim namaBulan As String
  VBA 00011 \|     Dim tahun As String
  VBA 00012 \|     Dim fso As Object
  VBA 00013 \|     Dim lastRowStok As Long
  VBA 00014 \|     Dim lastRowQty As Long
  VBA 00015 \|     
  VBA 00016 \|     ' Set Worksheet
  VBA 00017 \|     Set wsStok = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("STOK & BELANJA BAHAN")
  VBA 00018 \|     On Error Resume Next
  VBA 00019 \|     Set wsQty = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("PENJUALAN (QTY)")
  VBA 00020 \|     On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
  VBA 00021 \|     
  VBA 00022 \|     ' 1. Tentukan Nama File Backup & Tahun
  VBA 00023 \|     namaBulan = UCase(Format(Date, "mmmm")) ' Contoh: OKTOBER / OCTOBER
  VBA 00024 \|     tahun = Format(Date, "yyyy")          ' Contoh: 2026
  VBA 00025 \|     backupFileName = "LAPORAN " & namaBulan & " " & tahun & ".xlsm"
  VBA 00026 \|     
  VBA 00027 \|     ' 2. Menentukan Folder Utama & Sub-Folder [Tahun]
  VBA 00028 \|     mainFolderPath = "C:\Users\lenovo\OneDrive\Documents\JAGOAN CRISPY\LAPORAN PENJUALAN\"
  VBA 00029 \|     folderPath = mainFolderPath & tahun & "\"
  VBA 00030 \|     fullBackupPath = folderPath & backupFileName
  VBA 00031 \|     
  VBA 00032 \|     Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
  VBA 00033 \|     
  VBA 00034 \|     ' 3. PROTEKSI MUTLAK: JIKA FILE BACKUP SUDAH ADA, LANGSUNG HENTIKAN PROSES!
  VBA 00035 \|     If fso.FileExists(fullBackupPath) Then
  VBA 00036 \|         MsgBox "TUTUP BUKU DITOLAK / DIBATALKAN!" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00037 \|                "Laporan untuk periode " & namaBulan & " " & tahun & " sudah pernah dibuat." & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00038 \|                "File backup sudah tersimpan di:" & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00039 \|                backupFileName & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00040 \|                "Sistem membatalkan proses otomatis untuk mencegah hilangnya data laporan.", _
  VBA 00041 \|                vbCritical, "Akses Ditolak - Tutup Buku Ganda"
  VBA 00042 \|         Exit Sub
  VBA 00043 \|     End If
  VBA 00044 \|     
  VBA 00045 \|     ' 4. Konfirmasi Keikutsertaan Standar (Pertama Kali Tutup Buku)
  VBA 00046 \|     answer = MsgBox("Apakah Anda yakin ingin melakukan TUTUP BUKU BULANAN periode " & namaBulan & " " & tahun & "?" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00047 \|                     "- File ini akan di-backup otomatis ke sub-folder " & tahun & "." & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00048 \|                     "- Estimasi Sisa Stok akan dipindah ke Belanja Modal Bulan Lalu." & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00049 \|                     "- Log Catatan Belanja & Data Penjualan QTY akan dibersihkan.", _
  VBA 00050 \|                     vbQuestion + vbOKCancel, "Konfirmasi Tutup Buku Bulanan")
  VBA 00051 \|                     
  VBA 00052 \|     If answer = vbCancel Then
  VBA 00053 \|         MsgBox "Proses Tutup Buku dibatalkan.", vbInformation, "Batal"
  VBA 00054 \|         Exit Sub
  VBA 00055 \|     End If
  VBA 00056 \|     
  VBA 00057 \|     ' Buat folder utama & sub-folder [Tahun] otomatis jika belum ada di komputer
  VBA 00058 \|     If Not fso.FolderExists(mainFolderPath) Then
  VBA 00059 \|         On Error Resume Next
  VBA 00060 \|         fso.CreateFolder mainFolderPath
  VBA 00061 \|         On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
  VBA 00062 \|     End If
  VBA 00063 \|     
  VBA 00064 \|     If Not fso.FolderExists(folderPath) Then
  VBA 00065 \|         On Error Resume Next
  VBA 00066 \|         fso.CreateFolder folderPath
  VBA 00067 \|         On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
  VBA 00068 \|     End If
  VBA 00069 \|     
  VBA 00070 \|     ' 5. Simpan Backup File (SaveCopyAs)
  VBA 00071 \|     On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
  VBA 00072 \|     
  VBA 00073 \|     ' Simpan perubahan pada workbook utama terlebih dahulu
  VBA 00074 \|     ThisWorkbook.Save
  VBA 00075 \|     
  VBA 00076 \|     ' Buat salinan fisik file backup ke sub-folder tahun
  VBA 00077 \|     ThisWorkbook.SaveCopyAs fullBackupPath
  VBA 00078 \|     
  VBA 00079 \|     ' Verifikasi apakah file backup berhasil dibuat
  VBA 00080 \|     If Not fso.FileExists(fullBackupPath) Then
  VBA 00081 \|         Err.Raise Number:=9999, Description:="File backup tidak dapat ditemukan di lokasi: " & fullBackupPath
  VBA 00082 \|     End If
  VBA 00083 \|     
  VBA 00084 \|     ' 6. Eksekusi Pemindahan Data & Pembersihan (Hanya jika backup BERHASIL)
  VBA 00085 \|     Application.EnableEvents = False
  VBA 00086 \|     Application.ScreenUpdating = False
  VBA 00087 \|     
  VBA 00088 \|     ' A. Copy-Paste Values Sisa Stok (E12:E16) ke Modal Bulan Lalu (B12:B16) pada sheet STOK & BELANJA BAHAN
  VBA 00089 \|     wsStok.Range("B12:B16").value = wsStok.Range("E12:E16").value
  VBA 00090 \|     
  VBA 00091 \|     ' B. Bersihkan Log Catatan Belanja (A22:G ke bawah) pada sheet STOK & BELANJA BAHAN
  VBA 00092 \|     lastRowStok = wsStok.Cells(wsStok.Rows.Count, "C").End(xlUp).Row
  VBA 00093 \|     If lastRowStok >= 22 Then
  VBA 00094 \|         wsStok.Range("A22:G" & lastRowStok).ClearContents
  VBA 00095 \|     End If
  VBA 00096 \|     
  VBA 00097 \|     ' C. Bersihkan Data Penjualan QTY (C2:AG ke bawah) pada sheet PENJUALAN (QTY)
  VBA 00098 \|     If Not wsQty Is Nothing Then
  VBA 00099 \|         lastRowQty = wsQty.Cells(wsQty.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
  VBA 00100 \|         If lastRowQty < 2 Then
  VBA 00101 \|             lastRowQty = wsQty.Cells(wsQty.Rows.Count, "B").End(xlUp).Row
  VBA 00102 \|         End If
  VBA 00103 \|         
  VBA 00104 \|         If lastRowQty >= 2 Then
  VBA 00105 \|             wsQty.Range("C2:AG" & lastRowQty).ClearContents
  VBA 00106 \|         End If
  VBA 00107 \|     End If

  VBA 00110 \|     ThisWorkbook.Save
  VBA 00111 \|

  VBA 00113 \|     Application.ScreenUpdating = True

  VBA 00120 \|                               vbQuestion + vbYesNo, "Tutup Buku Selesai")
  VBA 00121 \|

  VBA 00124 \|         Shell "explorer.exe """ & folderPath & """", vbNormalFocus

  VBA 00204 \| Private Sub RefreshHelperLists()
  VBA 00205 \|     Dim wsL As Worksheet, wsP As Worksheet, wsB As Worksheet
  VBA 00206 \|     Dim loP As ListObject, loB As ListObject, loD As ListObject
  VBA 00207 \|     Dim r As Long, outP As Long, outB As Long, outProd As Long
  VBA 00208 \|     Dim code As String, productName As String, componentName As String
  VBA 00209 \|     Dim lastProd As Long, lastBahan As Long, lastCompProd As Long
  VBA 00210 \| 
  VBA 00211 \|     Set wsL = EnsureHelperSheet()
  VBA 00212 \|     Set wsP = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(SH_MASTER_PRODUK)
  VBA 00213 \|     Set wsB = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(SH_MASTER_BAHAN)
  VBA 00214 \|     Set loP = wsP.ListObjects(TBL_PRODUK)
  VBA 00215 \|     Set loB = wsB.ListObjects(TBL_BAHAN)
  VBA 00216 \|     Set loD = GetTable(SH_DETAIL, TBL_DETAIL)
  VBA 00217 \| 
  VBA 00218 \|     outP = 2
  VBA 00219 \|     outB = 2
  VBA 00220 \|     outProd = 2
  VBA 00221 \| 
  VBA 00222 \|     If Not loP.DataBodyRange Is Nothing Then
  VBA 00223 \|         For r = 1 To loP.DataBodyRange.Rows.Count
  VBA 00224 \|             code = Trim$(CStr(loP.ListColumns("KODE PRODUK").DataBodyRange.Cells(r, 1).value))
  VBA 00225 \|             productName = Trim$(CStr(loP.ListColumns("NAMA PRODUK").DataBodyRange.Cells(r, 1).value))
  VBA 00226 \|             If Len(code) > 0 And Len(productName) > 0 Then
  VBA 00227 \|                 wsL.Cells(outProd, 3).value = productName
  VBA 00228 \|                 outProd = outProd + 1
  VBA 00229 \|                 If Not IsProductAlreadyRegistered(code, loD) Then
  VBA 00230 \|                     wsL.Cells(outP, 1).value = productName
  VBA 00231 \|                     outP = outP + 1
  VBA 00232 \|                 End If
  VBA 00233 \|             End If
  VBA 00234 \|         Next r
  VBA 00235 \|     End If
  VBA 00236 \| 
  VBA 00237 \|     If Not loB.DataBodyRange Is Nothing Then
  VBA 00238 \|         For r = 1 To loB.DataBodyRange.Rows.Count
  VBA 00239 \|             componentName = Trim$(CStr(loB.ListColumns("NAMA KOMPONEN").DataBodyRange.Cells(r, 1).value))
  VBA 00240 \|             If Len(componentName) > 0 Then
  VBA 00241 \|                 wsL.Cells(outB, 2).value = componentName
  VBA 00242 \|                 outB = outB + 1
  VBA 00243 \|             End If
  VBA 00244 \|         Next r
  VBA 00245 \|     End If
  VBA 00246 \| 
  VBA 00247 \|     wsL.Range("D2").value = "BAHAN"
  VBA 00248 \|     wsL.Range("D3").value = "PRODUK"
  VBA 00249 \| 
  VBA 00250 \|     If outP = 2 Then wsL.Range("A2").value = "(TIDAK ADA PRODUK BARU)"
  VBA 00251 \|     If outB = 2 Then wsL.Range("B2").value = "(TIDAK ADA BAHAN)"
  VBA 00252 \|     If outProd = 2 Then wsL.Range("C2").value = "(TIDAK ADA PRODUK)"
  VBA 00253 \| 
  VBA 00254 \|     lastProd = IIf(outP > 2, outP - 1, 2)
  VBA 00255 \|     lastBahan = IIf(outB > 2, outB - 1, 2)
  VBA 00256 \|     lastCompProd = IIf(outProd > 2, outProd - 1, 2)
  VBA 00257 \| 
  VBA 00258 \|     SetOrReplaceName "HPPProdukBaru", "='" & SH_HELPER & "'!$A$2:$A$" & lastProd
  VBA 00259 \|     SetOrReplaceName "HPPDaftarBahan", "='" & SH_HELPER & "'!$B$2:$B$" & lastBahan
  VBA 00260 \|     SetOrReplaceName "HPPDaftarProduk", "='" & SH_HELPER & "'!$C$2:$C$" & lastCompProd
  VBA 00261 \|     SetOrReplaceName "HPPJenisKomponen", "='" & SH_HELPER & "'!$D$2:$D$3"
  VBA 00262 \| End Sub

  VBA 00264 \| Private Function IsProductAlreadyRegistered(ByVal productCode As String, ByVal loDetail As ListObject) As Boolean
  VBA 00265 \|     Dim r As Long
  VBA 00266 \| 
  VBA 00267 \|     ' Dropdown hanya mengecualikan produk yang resepnya sudah tercatat di DETAIL HPP.
  VBA 00268 \|     IsProductAlreadyRegistered = False
  VBA 00269 \| 
  VBA 00270 \|     If loDetail Is Nothing Then Exit Function
  VBA 00271 \|     If loDetail.DataBodyRange Is Nothing Then Exit Function
  VBA 00272 \| 
  VBA 00273 \|     For r = 1 To loDetail.DataBodyRange.Rows.Count
  VBA 00274 \|         If StrComp(Trim$(CStr(loDetail.ListColumns("KODE PRODUK").DataBodyRange.Cells(r, 1).value)), _
  VBA 00275 \|                    Trim$(productCode), vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
  VBA 00276 \|             IsProductAlreadyRegistered = True
  VBA 00277 \|             Exit Function
  VBA 00278 \|         End If
  VBA 00279 \|     Next r
  VBA 00280 \| End Function

  VBA 00591 \|     Exit Sub
  VBA 00592 \| ErrHandler:
  VBA 00593 \|     MsgBox "Gagal memperbarui dropdown: " & Err.Description, vbExclamation, "FORM HPP"
  VBA 00594 \| End Sub
  VBA 00595 \| 
  VBA 00596 \| Public Sub BersihkanFormHPP()
  VBA 00597 \|     Dim ws As Worksheet
  VBA 00598 \|     Set ws = GetWorksheet(SH_FORM)
  VBA 00599 \|     If ws Is Nothing Then
  VBA 00600 \|         MsgBox "Sheet FORM HPP belum dibuat.", vbExclamation, "FORM HPP"
  VBA 00601 \|         Exit Sub
  VBA 00602 \|     End If
  VBA 00603 \| 
  VBA 00604 \|     If MsgBox("Bersihkan pilihan produk dan seluruh input komponen yang belum disimpan? Data di DETAIL HPP tidak akan dihapus.", vbYesNo + vbQuestion, "Bersihkan Form") <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  VBA 00605 \| 
  VBA 00606 \|     ws.Range("B3:D3").ClearContents  ' Bersihkan seluruh area merge B3:D3
  VBA 00607 \|     ws.Range("A" & FORM_FIRST_ROW & ":B" & FORM_LAST_ROW).ClearContents
  VBA 00608 \|     ws.Range("E" & FORM_FIRST_ROW & ":F" & FORM_LAST_ROW).ClearContents
  VBA 00609 \|     ws.Calculate
  VBA 00610 \| End Sub

  VBA 00612 \| Public Sub SimpanResepHPP()
  VBA 00613 \|     Dim wsF As Worksheet
  VBA 00614 \|     Dim loP As ListObject, loB As ListObject, loD As ListObject
  VBA 00615 \|     Dim prodName As String, prodCode As String
  VBA 00616 \|     Dim r As Long, countParts As Long, rowTouched As Boolean
  VBA 00617 \|     Dim arrRows() As Long, idx As Long
  VBA 00618 \|     Dim compType As String, compName As String, compCode As String, unitName As String, statusText As String
  VBA 00619 \|     Dim qty As Double
  VBA 00620 \|     Dim newListRow As ListRow
  VBA 00621 \|     Dim originalCount As Long, addedCount As Long
  VBA 00622 \|     Dim saveStage As String
  VBA 00623 \|     Dim saveErrNumber As Long, saveErrDescription As String
  VBA 00624 \|     Dim saveCommitted As Boolean
  VBA 00625 \| 
  VBA 00626 \|     If Not ValidatePrerequisites() Then Exit Sub
  VBA 00627 \|     Set wsF = GetWorksheet(SH_FORM)
  VBA 00628 \|     Set loP = GetTable(SH_MASTER_PRODUK, TBL_PRODUK)
  VBA 00629 \|     Set loB = GetTable(SH_MASTER_BAHAN, TBL_BAHAN)
  VBA 00630 \|     Set loD = GetTable(SH_DETAIL, TBL_DETAIL)
  VBA 00631 \| 
  VBA 00632 \|     If wsF Is Nothing Or loD Is Nothing Then
  VBA 00633 \|         MsgBox "FORM HPP atau tblDetailHPP belum dibuat. Jalankan BuatFORMHPPdanDETAILHPP dahulu.", vbExclamation, "Simpan Resep"
  VBA 00634 \|         Exit Sub
  VBA 00635 \|     End If
  VBA 00636 \| 
  VBA 00637 \|     On Error GoTo PreSaveFail
  VBA 00638 \|     RefreshHelperLists
  VBA 00639 \|     wsF.Calculate
  VBA 00640 \| 
  VBA 00641 \|     prodName = Trim$(CStr(wsF.Range("B3").value))
  VBA 00642 \|     prodCode = Trim$(CStr(wsF.Range("F3").value))
  VBA 00643 \| 
  VBA 00644 \|     If Len(prodName) = 0 Or Len(prodCode) = 0 Then
  VBA 00645 \|         MsgBox "Pilih NAMA PRODUK dari dropdown terlebih dahulu.", vbExclamation, "Simpan Resep"
  VBA 00646 \|         Exit Sub
  VBA 00647 \|     End If
  VBA 00648 \| 
  VBA 00649 \|     If Not ProductCodeExistsInMaster(prodCode) Then
  VBA 00650 \|         MsgBox "Kode produk tidak ditemukan di tbl_Produk. Tambahkan produk terlebih dahulu ke MASTER PRODUK.", vbExclamation, "Simpan Resep"
  VBA 00651 \|         Exit Sub
  VBA 00652 \|     End If
  VBA 00653 \| 
  VBA 00654 \|     If IsProductAlreadyRegistered(prodCode, loD) Then
  VBA 00655 \|         MsgBox "Produk " & prodCode & " sudah memiliki resep di DETAIL HPP. Resep baru tidak disimpan untuk mencegah duplikasi.", vbExclamation, "Simpan Resep"
  VBA 00656 \|         RefreshHelperLists
  VBA 00657 \|         Exit Sub
  VBA 00658 \|     End If
  VBA 00659 \| 
  VBA 00660 \|     countParts = 0
  VBA 00661 \|     ReDim arrRows(1 To FORM_LAST_ROW - FORM_FIRST_ROW + 1)
  VBA 00662 \| 
  VBA 00663 \|     For r = FORM_FIRST_ROW To FORM_LAST_ROW
  VBA 00664 \|         compType = UCase$(Trim$(CStr(wsF.Cells(r, "A").value)))
  VBA 00665 \|         compName = Trim$(CStr(wsF.Cells(r, "B").value))
  VBA 00666 \|         unitName = Trim$(CStr(wsF.Cells(r, "F").value))
  VBA 00667 \|         rowTouched = (Len(compType) > 0 Or Len(compName) > 0 Or Len(Trim$(CStr(wsF.Cells(r, "E").value))) > 0 Or Len(unitName) > 0)
  VBA 00668 \| 
  VBA 00669 \|         If rowTouched Then
  VBA 00670 \|             If compType <> "BAHAN" And compType <> "PRODUK" Then
  VBA 00671 \|                 MsgBox "Baris " & r & ": pilih JENIS KOMPONEN (BAHAN/PRODUK).", vbExclamation, "Simpan Resep"
  VBA 00672 \|                 Exit Sub
  VBA 00673 \|             End If
  VBA 00674 \|             If Len(compName) = 0 Then
  VBA 00675 \|                 MsgBox "Baris " & r & ": pilih NAMA KOMPONEN.", vbExclamation, "Simpan Resep"
  VBA 00676 \|                 Exit Sub
  VBA 00677 \|             End If
  VBA 00678 \|             If Not IsNumeric(wsF.Cells(r, "E").value) Then
  VBA 00679 \|                 MsgBox "Baris " & r & ": QTY PAKAI harus berupa angka lebih besar dari nol.", vbExclamation, "Simpan Resep"
  VBA 00680 \|                 Exit Sub
  VBA 00681 \|             End If
  VBA 00682 \|             qty = CDbl(wsF.Cells(r, "E").value)
  VBA 00683 \|             If qty <= 0 Then
  VBA 00684 \|                 MsgBox "Baris " & r & ": QTY PAKAI harus lebih besar dari nol.", vbExclamation, "Simpan Resep"
  VBA 00685 \|                 Exit Sub
  VBA 00686 \|             End If
  VBA 00687 \|             If Len(unitName) = 0 Then
  VBA 00688 \|                 MsgBox "Baris " & r & ": SATUAN PAKAI belum diisi.", vbExclamation, "Simpan Resep"
  VBA 00689 \|                 Exit Sub
  VBA 00690 \|             End If
  VBA 00691 \| 
  VBA 00692 \|             compCode = Trim$(CStr(wsF.Cells(r, "C").value))
  VBA 00693 \|             statusText = Trim$(CStr(wsF.Cells(r, "I").value))
  VBA 00694 \|             If Len(compCode) = 0 Then
  VBA 00695 \|                 MsgBox "Baris " & r & ": kode komponen tidak ditemukan. Periksa nama komponen dan master sumber.", vbExclamation, "Simpan Resep"
  VBA 00696 \|                 Exit Sub
  VBA 00697 \|             End If
  VBA 00698 \|             If StrComp(compCode, prodCode, vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
  VBA 00699 \|                 MsgBox "Baris " & r & ": produk tidak boleh menggunakan dirinya sendiri sebagai komponen.", vbExclamation, "Simpan Resep"
  VBA 00700 \|                 Exit Sub
  VBA 00701 \|             End If
  VBA 00702 \|             If statusText <> "OK" Then
  VBA 00703 \|                 MsgBox "Baris " & r & " belum valid: " & statusText & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00704 \|                        "Perbaiki harga, qty, atau satuan sebelum menyimpan resep.", vbExclamation, "Simpan Resep"
  VBA 00705 \|                 Exit Sub
  VBA 00706 \|             End If
  VBA 00707 \| 
  VBA 00708 \|             countParts = countParts + 1
  VBA 00709 \|             arrRows(countParts) = r
  VBA 00710 \|         End If
  VBA 00711 \|     Next r
  VBA 00712 \| 
  VBA 00713 \|     If countParts = 0 Then
  VBA 00714 \|         MsgBox "Masukkan setidaknya satu komponen resep sebelum menyimpan.", vbExclamation, "Simpan Resep"
  VBA 00715 \|         Exit Sub
  VBA 00716 \|     End If
  VBA 00717 \| 
  VBA 00718 \|     If MsgBox("Simpan resep untuk:" & vbCrLf & prodName & " (" & prodCode & ")" & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00719 \|                "Jumlah komponen: " & countParts & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00720 \|                "Data komponen akan ditambahkan ke DETAIL HPP.", _
  VBA 00721 \|                vbYesNo + vbQuestion, "Konfirmasi Simpan Resep") <> vbYes Then Exit Sub
  VBA 00722 \| 
  VBA 00723 \|     originalCount = loD.ListRows.Count
  VBA 00724 \|     addedCount = 0
  VBA 00725 \|     saveCommitted = False
  VBA 00726 \|     saveStage = "menambahkan data ke tblDetailHPP"
  VBA 00727 \|     Application.ScreenUpdating = False
  VBA 00728 \|     Application.EnableEvents = False
  VBA 00729 \|     On Error GoTo SaveFail
  VBA 00730 \| 
  VBA 00731 \|     For idx = 1 To countParts
  VBA 00732 \|         r = arrRows(idx)
  VBA 00733 \|         saveStage = "menambahkan baris komponen " & idx & " dari " & countParts
  VBA 00734 \|         Set newListRow = loD.ListRows.Add
  VBA 00735 \|         addedCount = addedCount + 1
  VBA 00736 \| 
  VBA 00737 \|         saveStage = "mengisi kode produk, jenis komponen, kode komponen, qty, dan satuan pada baris " & idx
  VBA 00738 \|         With newListRow.Range
  VBA 00739 \|             .Cells(1, 1).value = prodCode
  VBA 00740 \|             .Cells(1, 3).value = UCase$(Trim$(CStr(wsF.Cells(r, "A").value)))
  VBA 00741 \|             .Cells(1, 4).value = Trim$(CStr(wsF.Cells(r, "C").value))
  VBA 00742 \|             .Cells(1, 7).value = CDbl(wsF.Cells(r, "E").value)
  VBA 00743 \|             .Cells(1, 8).value = Trim$(CStr(wsF.Cells(r, "F").value))
  VBA 00744 \|         End With
  VBA 00745 \| 
  VBA 00746 \|         saveStage = "memasang rumus otomatis pada baris komponen " & idx
  VBA 00747 \|         ApplyDetailRowFormulas newListRow.Range
  VBA 00748 \|     Next idx
  VBA 00749 \| 
  VBA 00750 \|     saveStage = "menghitung ulang tabel DETAIL HPP"
  VBA 00751 \|     loD.Parent.Calculate
  VBA 00752 \|     saveCommitted = True
  VBA 00753 \| 
  VBA 00754 \|     saveStage = "memperbarui dropdown sesudah penyimpanan"
  VBA 00755 \|     RefreshHelperLists
  VBA 00756 \|     wsF.Calculate
  VBA 00757 \| 
  VBA 00758 \|     saveStage = "membersihkan form sesudah penyimpanan berhasil"
  VBA 00759 \|     wsF.Range("B3:D3").ClearContents  ' Bersihkan seluruh area merge B3:D3
  VBA 00760 \|     wsF.Range("A" & FORM_FIRST_ROW & ":B" & FORM_LAST_ROW).ClearContents
  VBA 00761 \|     wsF.Range("E" & FORM_FIRST_ROW & ":F" & FORM_LAST_ROW).ClearContents
  VBA 00762 \|     wsF.Calculate
  VBA 00763 \| 
  VBA 00764 \|     Application.EnableEvents = True
  VBA 00765 \|     Application.ScreenUpdating = True
  VBA 00766 \| 
  VBA 00767 \|     MsgBox "Resep berhasil disimpan ke DETAIL HPP." & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00768 \|            "Kode produk: " & prodCode & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00769 \|            "Komponen tersimpan: " & countParts & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00770 \|            "Periksa rincian yang tersimpan pada tabel DETAIL HPP.", vbInformation, "Simpan Resep Berhasil"
  VBA 00771 \|     Exit Sub
  VBA 00772 \| 
  VBA 00773 \| PreSaveFail:
  VBA 00774 \|     saveErrNumber = Err.Number
  VBA 00775 \|     saveErrDescription = Err.Description
  VBA 00776 \|     MsgBox "Proses berhenti sebelum data disimpan." & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00777 \|            "Tahap: memuat daftar produk/komponen atau menghitung form." & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00778 \|            "Nomor error: " & saveErrNumber & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00779 \|            "Pesan: " & saveErrDescription, vbExclamation, "FORM HPP - Diagnostik"
  VBA 00780 \|     Exit Sub
  VBA 00781 \| 
  VBA 00782 \| SaveFail:
  VBA 00783 \|     ' Simpan detail error SEBELUM rollback, sebab operasi cleanup dapat mengosongkan Err.Description.
  VBA 00784 \|     saveErrNumber = Err.Number
  VBA 00785 \|     saveErrDescription = Err.Description
  VBA 00786 \| 
  VBA 00787 \|     On Error Resume Next
  VBA 00788 \|     If Not saveCommitted Then
  VBA 00789 \|         Do While loD.ListRows.Count > originalCount
  VBA 00790 \|             loD.ListRows(loD.ListRows.Count).Delete
  VBA 00791 \|         Loop
  VBA 00792 \|     End If
  VBA 00793 \|     Application.EnableEvents = True
  VBA 00794 \|     Application.ScreenUpdating = True
  VBA 00795 \|     On Error GoTo 0
  VBA 00796 \| 
  VBA 00797 \|     If saveCommitted Then
  VBA 00798 \|         MsgBox "Baris resep sudah masuk ke DETAIL HPP, tetapi proses lanjutan gagal." & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00799 \|                "Data tidak dihapus karena sudah tersimpan." & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00800 \|                "Tahap: " & saveStage & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00801 \|                "Nomor error: " & saveErrNumber & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00802 \|                "Pesan: " & saveErrDescription, vbExclamation, "FORM HPP - Diagnostik"
  VBA 00803 \|     Else
  VBA 00804 \|         MsgBox "Penyimpanan gagal. Baris baru yang sempat ditambahkan telah dibatalkan." & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00805 \|                "Tahap: " & saveStage & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00806 \|                "Nomor error: " & saveErrNumber & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00807 \|                "Pesan: " & saveErrDescription & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00808 \|                "Kirimkan nomor dan pesan error ini agar penyebabnya dapat diperbaiki.", vbExclamation, "FORM HPP - Diagnostik"
  VBA 00809 \|     End If
  VBA 00810 \| End Sub
  VBA 00811 \| 
  VBA 00812 \| Private Function ProductCodeExistsInMaster(ByVal productCode As String) As Boolean
  VBA 00813 \|     Dim loP As ListObject
  VBA 00814 \|     Dim f As Range
  VBA 00815 \|     Set loP = GetTable(SH_MASTER_PRODUK, TBL_PRODUK)
  VBA 00816 \|     If loP Is Nothing Then Exit Function
  VBA 00817 \|     If loP.DataBodyRange Is Nothing Then Exit Function
  VBA 00818 \|     Set f = loP.ListColumns("KODE PRODUK").DataBodyRange.Find(What:=productCode, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
  VBA 00819 \|     ProductCodeExistsInMaster = Not f Is Nothing
  VBA 00820 \| End Function

  VBA 00012 \| Public Sub PetaWorkbookLengkap()
  VBA 00013 \|     Dim targetPath As Variant
  VBA 00014 \|     Dim fileNo As Integer
  VBA 00015 \|     Dim fileIsOpen As Boolean
  VBA 00016 \|     Dim oldScreenUpdating As Boolean
  VBA 00017 \|     Dim oldEnableEvents As Boolean
  VBA 00018 \|     Dim wb As Workbook
  VBA 00019 \|     Dim ws As Worksheet
  VBA 00020 \|     Dim lo As ListObject
  VBA 00021 \|     Dim nm As Name
  VBA 00022 \|     Dim conn As Object
  VBA 00023 \|     Dim links As Variant
  VBA 00024 \|     Dim i As Long
  VBA 00025 \| 
  VBA 00026 \|     Set wb = ThisWorkbook
  VBA 00027 \|     targetPath = Application.GetSaveAsFilename( _
  VBA 00028 \|         InitialFileName:="PETA_WORKBOOK_" & FileStem(wb.Name) & "_" & Format(Now, "yyyymmdd_hhnnss") & ".txt", _
  VBA 00029 \|         FileFilter:="Text Files (*.txt), *.txt", _
  VBA 00030 \|         Title:="Simpan Peta Workbook Lengkap")
  VBA 00031 \| 
  VBA 00032 \|     If VarType(targetPath) = vbBoolean Then Exit Sub
  VBA 00033 \|     If Len(Trim$(CStr(targetPath))) = 0 Then Exit Sub

  VBA 00036 \|     oldEnableEvents = Application.EnableEvents
  VBA 00037 \|     Application.ScreenUpdating = False
  VBA 00038 \|     Application.EnableEvents = False
  VBA 00039 \|     On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
  VBA 00040 \| 
  VBA 00041 \|     fileNo = FreeFile
  VBA 00042 \|     Open CStr(targetPath) For Output As #fileNo
  VBA 00043 \|     fileIsOpen = True
  VBA 00044 \| 
  VBA 00045 \|     WriteLine fileNo, String$(92, "=")
  VBA 00046 \|     WriteLine fileNo, "PETA WORKBOOK LENGKAP - STRUKTUR, ISI SEL, FORMULA, DAN VBA"
  VBA 00047 \|     WriteLine fileNo, String$(92, "=")
  VBA 00048 \|     WriteLine fileNo, "Waktu ekspor       : " & Format(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss")

  VBA 00051 \|     WriteLine fileNo, "Excel version      : " & Application.Version

  VBA 00056 \|     WriteLine fileNo, "Update links       : " & CStr(wb.UpdateRemoteReferences)
  VBA 00057 \|     WriteLine fileNo, ""
  VBA 00058 \|

  VBA 00061 \|     WriteLine fileNo, String$(92, "=")

  VBA 00063 \|         WriteLine fileNo, "SHEET: " & ws.Name
  VBA 00064 \|         WriteLine fileNo, "  CodeName        : " & ws.CodeName

  VBA 00070 \|         WriteSheetTables fileNo, ws

  VBA 00073 \|         WriteSheetConditionalFormats fileNo, ws

  VBA 00076 \|     Next ws
  VBA 00077 \| 
  VBA 00078 \|     WriteLine fileNo, String$(92, "=")
  VBA 00079 \|     WriteLine fileNo, "BAGIAN 2 - DEFINED NAMES / NAMED RANGES"
  VBA 00080 \|     WriteLine fileNo, String$(92, "=")
  VBA 00081 \|     If wb.Names.Count = 0 Then
  VBA 00082 \|         WriteLine fileNo, "Tidak ada defined names pada workbook."
  VBA 00083 \|     Else
  VBA 00084 \|         For Each nm In wb.Names
  VBA 00085 \|             WriteLine fileNo, "NAME: " & nm.Name
  VBA 00086 \|             WriteLine fileNo, "  RefersTo : " & SafeText(nm.RefersTo)
  VBA 00087 \|             WriteLine fileNo, "  Visible  : " & SafeText(nm.Visible)
  VBA 00088 \|         Next nm
  VBA 00089 \|     End If
  VBA 00090 \|     WriteLine fileNo, ""
  VBA 00091 \| 
  VBA 00092 \|     WriteLine fileNo, String$(92, "=")
  VBA 00093 \|     WriteLine fileNo, "BAGIAN 3 - WORKSHEET-SCOPED NAMES"
  VBA 00094 \|     WriteLine fileNo, String$(92, "=")
  VBA 00095 \|     For Each ws In wb.Worksheets
  VBA 00096 \|         On Error Resume Next
  VBA 00097 \|         If ws.Names.Count > 0 Then
  VBA 00098 \|             WriteLine fileNo, "SHEET: " & ws.Name
  VBA 00099 \|             For Each nm In ws.Names
  VBA 00100 \|                 WriteLine fileNo, "  NAME: " & nm.Name & " \| RefersTo=" & SafeText(nm.RefersTo)
  VBA 00101 \|             Next nm
  VBA 00102 \|         End If
  VBA 00103 \|         Err.Clear
  VBA 00104 \|         On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
  VBA 00105 \|     Next ws

  VBA 00117 \|         For i = LBound(links) To UBound(links)
  VBA 00118 \|             WriteLine fileNo, "EXTERNAL LINK: " & SafeText(links(i))
  VBA 00119 \|         Next i
  VBA 00120 \|     Else
  VBA 00121 \|         WriteLine fileNo, "Tidak ditemukan external Excel links."
  VBA 00122 \|     End If
  VBA 00123 \|     Err.Clear
  VBA 00124 \|     On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
  VBA 00125 \| 
  VBA 00126 \|     On Error Resume Next
  VBA 00127 \|     If wb.Connections.Count = 0 Then
  VBA 00128 \|         WriteLine fileNo, "Tidak ditemukan workbook connections."
  VBA 00129 \|     Else
  VBA 00130 \|         For Each conn In wb.Connections
  VBA 00131 \|             WriteLine fileNo, "CONNECTION: " & SafeText(conn.Name) & " \| Type=" & SafeText(conn.Type)
  VBA 00132 \|         Next conn
  VBA 00133 \|     End If
  VBA 00134 \|     Err.Clear
  VBA 00135 \|     On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
  VBA 00136 \|     WriteLine fileNo, ""
  VBA 00137 \| 
  VBA 00138 \|     WriteLine fileNo, String$(92, "=")
  VBA 00139 \|     WriteLine fileNo, "BAGIAN 5 - SELURUH KOMPONEN DAN SOURCE CODE VBA"
  VBA 00140 \|     WriteLine fileNo, String$(92, "=")
  VBA 00141 \|     WriteVBAProject fileNo, wb
  VBA 00142 \| 
  VBA 00143 \|     WriteLine fileNo, ""
  VBA 00144 \|     WriteLine fileNo, String$(92, "=")
  VBA 00145 \|     WriteLine fileNo, "AKHIR LAPORAN"
  VBA 00146 \|     WriteLine fileNo, "Sumber laporan: " & wb.FullName
  VBA 00147 \|     WriteLine fileNo, "Waktu selesai : " & Format(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss")
  VBA 00148 \|     WriteLine fileNo, String$(92, "=")
  VBA 00149 \| 
  VBA 00150 \|     Close #fileNo
  VBA 00151 \|     fileIsOpen = False
  VBA 00152 \|     Application.ScreenUpdating = oldScreenUpdating
  VBA 00153 \|     Application.EnableEvents = oldEnableEvents
  VBA 00154 \|     MsgBox "Peta workbook selesai dibuat:" & vbCrLf & CStr(targetPath), vbInformation, "Peta Workbook Lengkap"
  VBA 00155 \|     Exit Sub
  VBA 00156 \| 
  VBA 00157 \| ErrorHandler:
  VBA 00158 \|     Dim errMsg As String
  VBA 00159 \|     errMsg = "Gagal membuat peta workbook." & vbCrLf & "Error " & Err.Number & ": " & Err.Description
  VBA 00160 \|     On Error Resume Next

  VBA 00363 \| Private Function FileStem(ByVal fileName As String) As String
  VBA 00364 \|     Dim p As Long
  VBA 00365 \|     p = InStrRev(fileName, ".")
  VBA 00366 \|     If p > 1 Then fileName = Left$(fileName, p - 1)
  VBA 00367 \|     FileStem = Replace(Replace(Replace(fileName, "\", "_"), "/", "_"), ":", "_")
  VBA 00368 \| End Function

  VBA 00370 \| Private Function SafeText(ByVal value As Variant) As String
  VBA 00371 \|     Dim s As String
  VBA 00372 \|     If IsError(value) Then
  VBA 00373 \|         SafeText = "#ERROR"
  VBA 00374 \|         Exit Function
  VBA 00375 \|     End If
  VBA 00376 \|     If IsNull(value) Then
  VBA 00377 \|         SafeText = "<NULL>"
  VBA 00378 \|         Exit Function
  VBA 00379 \|     End If
  VBA 00380 \|     If IsEmpty(value) Then
  VBA 00381 \|         SafeText = ""
  VBA 00382 \|         Exit Function
  VBA 00383 \|     End If
  VBA 00384 \|     On Error Resume Next
  VBA 00385 \|     s = CStr(value)
  VBA 00386 \|     If Err.Number <> 0 Then
  VBA 00387 \|         s = "<UNREADABLE>"
  VBA 00388 \|         Err.Clear
  VBA 00389 \|     End If
  VBA 00390 \|     On Error GoTo 0
  VBA 00391 \|     s = Replace(s, vbCrLf, " ")
  VBA 00392 \|     s = Replace(s, vbCr, " ")
  VBA 00393 \|     s = Replace(s, vbLf, " ")
  VBA 00394 \|     s = Replace(s, vbTab, " ")
  VBA 00395 \|     s = Replace(s, "\|", "\\|")
  VBA 00396 \|     SafeText = s
  VBA 00397 \| End Function
  VBA 00398 \| 
  VBA 00399 \| Private Sub WriteLine(ByVal fileNo As Integer, ByVal textLine As String)
  VBA 00400 \|     Print #fileNo, SafeText(textLine)
  VBA 00401 \| End Sub

  VBA 00331 \| Private Function EnsurePurchaseTable(ByVal wsLog As Worksheet) As ListObject
  VBA 00332 \|     Dim lo As ListObject
  VBA 00333 \|     Dim tbl As ListObject
  VBA 00334 \|     Dim headers As Variant
  VBA 00335 \|     Dim lastDataRow As Long
  VBA 00336 \|     Dim tableLastRow As Long
  VBA 00337 \|     Dim candidateRange As Range
  VBA 00338 \|     Dim overlapRange As Range
  VBA 00339 \|     Dim i As Long
  VBA 00340 \| 
  VBA 00341 \|     headers = Array("TANGGAL", "NO NOTA/TOKO", "KODE BAHAN", "NAMA BAHAN", "QTY BELI", "SATUAN", "TOTAL BELANJA (RP)")
  VBA 00342 \|     Set tbl = Nothing
  VBA 00343 \| 
  VBA 00344 \|     For Each lo In wsLog.ListObjects
  VBA 00345 \|         If lo.Range.Row = LOG_HEADER_ROW And lo.Range.Column = 1 And lo.ListColumns.Count = 7 Then
  VBA 00346 \|             Set tbl = lo
  VBA 00347 \|             Exit For
  VBA 00348 \|         End If
  VBA 00349 \|     Next lo
  VBA 00350 \| 
  VBA 00351 \|     lastDataRow = LastPurchaseDataRow(wsLog)
  VBA 00352 \|     tableLastRow = lastDataRow
  VBA 00353 \|     If tableLastRow < LOG_FIRST_DATA_ROW Then tableLastRow = LOG_FIRST_DATA_ROW
  VBA 00354 \|     Set candidateRange = wsLog.Range("A" & LOG_HEADER_ROW & ":G" & tableLastRow)
  VBA 00355 \| 
  VBA 00356 \|     If tbl Is Nothing Then
  VBA 00357 \|         For Each lo In wsLog.ListObjects
  VBA 00358 \|             Set overlapRange = Nothing
  VBA 00359 \|             On Error Resume Next
  VBA 00360 \|             Set overlapRange = Intersect(lo.Range, candidateRange)
  VBA 00361 \|             On Error GoTo 0
  VBA 00362 \|             If Not overlapRange Is Nothing Then
  VBA 00363 \|                 MsgBox "Tidak dapat membuat tblLogBelanja karena range A24:G" & tableLastRow & " beririsan dengan tabel lain '" & lo.Name & "'. Periksa posisi tabel di sheet " & SHEET_LOG & ".", vbCritical, "Form Belanja"
  VBA 00364 \|                 Exit Function
  VBA 00365 \|             End If
  VBA 00366 \|         Next lo
  VBA 00367 \| 
  VBA 00368 \|         On Error GoTo CreateTableError
  VBA 00369 \|         Set tbl = wsLog.ListObjects.Add(SourceType:=xlSrcRange, Source:=candidateRange, XlListObjectHasHeaders:=xlYes)
  VBA 00370 \|         On Error GoTo 0
  VBA 00371 \|     Else
  VBA 00372 \|         On Error GoTo ResizeTableError
  VBA 00373 \|         tbl.Resize candidateRange
  VBA 00374 \|         On Error GoTo 0
  VBA 00375 \|     End If
  VBA 00376 \| 
  VBA 00377 \|     On Error Resume Next
  VBA 00378 \|     If StrComp(tbl.Name, TABLE_LOG, vbTextCompare) <> 0 Then tbl.Name = TABLE_LOG
  VBA 00379 \|     If Err.Number <> 0 Then
  VBA 00380 \|         Err.Clear
  VBA 00381 \|         ' Jika nama tabel sudah dipakai objek lain, tetap gunakan tabel di A24:G.
  VBA 00382 \|     End If
  VBA 00383 \|     On Error GoTo 0
  VBA 00384 \| 
  VBA 00385 \|     For i = LBound(headers) To UBound(headers)
  VBA 00386 \|         tbl.HeaderRowRange.Cells(1, i + 1).value = headers(i)
  VBA 00387 \|     Next i
  VBA 00388 \|     tbl.ShowAutoFilter = True
  VBA 00389 \|     tbl.TableStyle = "TableStyleMedium2"
  VBA 00390 \|     Set EnsurePurchaseTable = tbl
  VBA 00391 \|     Exit Function
  VBA 00392 \| 
  VBA 00393 \| CreateTableError:
  VBA 00394 \|     MsgBox "Gagal membuat tabel belanja pada A24:G. Error " & Err.Number & ": " & Err.Description, vbExclamation, "Form Belanja"
  VBA 00395 \|     Set EnsurePurchaseTable = Nothing
  VBA 00396 \|     Exit Function
  VBA 00397 \| 
  VBA 00398 \| ResizeTableError:
  VBA 00399 \|     MsgBox "Gagal menyesuaikan ukuran tabel belanja. Data tidak ditulis. Error " & Err.Number & ": " & Err.Description, vbExclamation, "Form Belanja"
  VBA 00400 \|     Set EnsurePurchaseTable = Nothing
  VBA 00401 \| End Function

  VBA 00475 \| Private Function FindListColumnSheetNumber(ByVal lo As ListObject, ByVal aliases As Variant) As Long
  VBA 00476 \|     Dim lc As ListColumn

  VBA 00489 \| Private Function FindHeaderInRow(ByVal ws As Worksheet, ByVal rowNo As Long, ByVal firstCol As Long, ByVal lastCol As Long, ByVal aliases As Variant) As Long
  VBA 00490 \|     Dim colNo As Long
  VBA 00491 \|     Dim i As Long
  VBA 00492 \|     Dim cellValue As String
  VBA 00493 \|     For colNo = firstCol To lastCol
  VBA 00494 \|         cellValue = NormalizeHeader(CStr(ws.Cells(rowNo, colNo).Value2))
  VBA 00495 \|         For i = LBound(aliases) To UBound(aliases)
  VBA 00496 \|             If cellValue = NormalizeHeader(CStr(aliases(i))) Then
  VBA 00497 \|                 FindHeaderInRow = colNo
  VBA 00498 \|                 Exit Function
  VBA 00499 \|             End If
  VBA 00500 \|         Next i
  VBA 00501 \|     Next colNo
  VBA 00502 \|     FindHeaderInRow = 0
  VBA 00503 \| End Function
  VBA 00504 \| 
  VBA 00505 \| Private Function NormalizeHeader(ByVal value As String) As String
  VBA 00506 \|     value = UCase$(Trim$(value))
  VBA 00507 \|     value = Replace(value, "_", " ")
  VBA 00508 \|     value = Replace(value, vbCr, " ")
  VBA 00509 \|     value = Replace(value, vbLf, " ")
  VBA 00510 \|     Do While InStr(value, "  ") > 0
  VBA 00511 \|         value = Replace(value, "  ", " ")
  VBA 00512 \|     Loop
  VBA 00513 \|     NormalizeHeader = value
  VBA 00514 \| End Function

  VBA 00516 \| Private Function BuildMaterialListRef(ByVal wsMaster As Worksheet, ByVal sourceTable As ListObject, ByVal colName As Long, ByVal headerRow As Long, ByVal firstDataRow As Long, ByVal lastDataRow As Long) As String

  VBA 00524 \|         BuildMaterialListRef = "=OFFSET('" & wsMaster.Name & "'!$" & colLetter & "$" & firstDataRow & ",0,0,MAX(1,COUNTA('" & wsMaster.Name & "'!$" & colLetter & ":$" & colLetter & ")-1),1)"
  VBA 00525 \|     End If
  VBA 00526 \| End Function

  VBA 00540 \| Private Function FindMaterial(ByVal materialName As String, ByVal wsMaster As Worksheet, ByVal colCode As Long, ByVal colName As Long, ByVal colUnit As Long, ByVal colQty As Long, ByVal colPurchaseTotal As Long, ByVal firstDataRow As Long, ByVal lastDataRow As Long, ByRef materialCode As String, ByRef materialUnit As String, ByRef quantityDefault As Variant, ByRef totalDefault As Variant, ByRef matchCount As Long) As Boolean

  VBA 00554 \|                 End If
  VBA 00555 \|             End If
  VBA 00556 \|         End If
  VBA 00557 \|     Next r
  VBA 00558 \|     FindMaterial = (matchCount > 0 And Len(materialCode) > 0)
  VBA 00559 \| End Function

  VBA 00631 \| ' Mengecek kolom E (QTY BELI). QTY BELI wajib berupa nilai input, bukan formula.

  VBA 00633 \| Public Sub PerbaikiKolomQtyBeli()
  VBA 00634 \|     Dim wsLog As Worksheet
  VBA 00635 \|     Dim lastRow As Long, r As Long, formulaCount As Long
  VBA 00636 \|     Dim answer As VbMsgBoxResult
  VBA 00637 \|     Dim oldEvents As Boolean, oldAutoFill As Boolean
  VBA 00638 \|     Dim eventsCaptured As Boolean, autoFillCaptured As Boolean
  VBA 00639 \| 
  VBA 00640 \|     On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
  VBA 00641 \|     Set wsLog = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(SHEET_LOG)
  VBA 00642 \|     lastRow = LastPurchaseDataRow(wsLog)
  VBA 00643 \|     If lastRow < LOG_FIRST_DATA_ROW Then
  VBA 00644 \|         MsgBox "Tidak ada baris transaksi untuk diperiksa pada E25 ke bawah.", vbInformation, "Periksa QTY BELI"
  VBA 00645 \|         Exit Sub
  VBA 00646 \|     End If
  VBA 00647 \| 
  VBA 00648 \|     For r = LOG_FIRST_DATA_ROW To lastRow
  VBA 00649 \|         If wsLog.Cells(r, 5).hasFormula Then formulaCount = formulaCount + 1
  VBA 00650 \|     Next r
  VBA 00651 \| 
  VBA 00652 \|     If formulaCount = 0 Then
  VBA 00653 \|         wsLog.Range("E25:E" & lastRow).NumberFormat = "#,##0.###"
  VBA 00654 \|         MsgBox "Pemeriksaan selesai: tidak ditemukan rumus di kolom QTY BELI (E25:E" & lastRow & "). Nilai manual dipertahankan.", vbInformation, "Periksa QTY BELI"
  VBA 00655 \|         Exit Sub
  VBA 00656 \|     End If
  VBA 00657 \| 
  VBA 00658 \|     answer = MsgBox("Ditemukan " & formulaCount & " sel yang berisi rumus pada kolom QTY BELI (E25:E" & lastRow & ")." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00659 \|                     "Kolom ini harus berisi angka jumlah pembelian, bukan rumus HPP. Lanjutkan menghapus HANYA sel yang berisi rumus?" & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00660 \|                     "Sel rumus akan dikosongkan agar bisa diisi ulang dari nota. Nilai manual yang bukan rumus tidak diubah." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
  VBA 00661 \|                     "Pastikan workbook sudah disimpan sebagai cadangan.", vbYesNo + vbExclamation + vbDefaultButton2, "Perbaiki Rumus QTY BELI")

  VBA 00663 \| 
  VBA 00664 \|     oldEvents = Application.EnableEvents: eventsCaptured = True
  VBA 00665 \|     Application.EnableEvents = False
  VBA 00666 \|     On Error Resume Next
  VBA 00667 \|     oldAutoFill = Application.AutoCorrect.AutoFillFormulasInLists

  VBA 00670 \|         Application.AutoCorrect.AutoFillFormulasInLists = False

  VBA 00675 \|     For r = LOG_FIRST_DATA_ROW To lastRow
  VBA 00676 \|         If wsLog.Cells(r, 5).hasFormula Then wsLog.Cells(r, 5).ClearContents
  VBA 00677 \|     Next r
  VBA 00678 \|     wsLog.Range("E25:E" & lastRow).NumberFormat = "#,##0.###"
  VBA 00679 \|

  VBA 00681 \|     If eventsCaptured Then Application.EnableEvents = oldEvents
  VBA 00682 \|     autoFillCaptured = False: eventsCaptured = False
